title: ‘You Can See Everything’ Review: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s Elizabeth Holmes Documentary Is Boundary-Pushing and Absurd

summary: There are three weenies in "The Weenie": a secret compound that may hide the Manhunter, William Macon's, um, "elephant" in the room, and John Stewart himself. Each weenie tells a story, and each story tells us a lot about "Lanterns."
